title: Michael Mauboussin – Investing in times of (the Coronavirus) Crisis

reader_summary.overview: Today's conversation is with Michael Mauboussin, Head of Consilient Research at Counterpoint Global. Before joining Counterpoint Global. Michael has also authored several books and has been an adjunct professor of finance at Columbia Business School since 1993. As of this recording, the university campus is quiet and empty, with classes moving online for the spring semester.

key_points.text: Michael has also authored several books and has been an adjunct professor of finance at Columbia Business School since 1993.
Of course, this is due to the coronavirus global pandemic which hit the world quite suddenly and has required extreme public health measures.
